newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: State-run Colombian agency eyes $80 mln credit.
newsitem.headline: State-run Colombian agency eyes $80 mln credit.

text.p: A state-run company involved in financing the expansion of Colombia's power grid hopes to obtain an $80 million syndicated loan later this month, its president said.

Alberto Montoya, head of the Financiera Energetica Nacional (FEN), said the seven-year loan was being arranged by Santander Investment and Banco Exterior de Espana and that a formal presentation would be made to investors next week in New York.
"The operation should be closed by the end of October," Montoya said in a telephone interview.
The credit would be the second contracted by FEN since the start of the year, when it was granted a syndicated loan for $150 million.
In July FEN, which reported $2.5 billion in net assets in June, also issued $250 million in commercial paper in the United States.
